requirements.text: Ensure full compliance with regulatory requirements while modernising the app.
Implement real-time transaction notifications to enhance customer control and awareness.
Allow customers to manage their cards directly through the app, such as freezing and unfreezing, while adhering to security protocols.
Develop budgeting tools that categorize spending and set alerts for budget limits, ensuring compliance with consumer protection regulations.
Ensure all new features integrate with existing systems and align with security requirements.
